label: champ_0115_ecology_02
text: How goes your Treasure Hunt? Figured out what\nyou’re hunting for yet?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: champ_0115_ecology_03a
text: That’s great! Look at you, knowing exactly what\nyou’re after![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: champ_0115_ecology_03b
text: Haha. I get it. Director Clavell doesn’t like\nquestions with easy answers, does he?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: champ_0115_ecology_04
text: Many students choose to make the Gym circuit a\npart of their Treasure Hunt.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: champ_0115_ecology_05
text: It’s no easy feat, but even making the attempt is\na worthwhile experience.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: champ_0115_ecology_06
text: That’s why I was waiting here—to make sure you\nknow your homeroom teacher’s got your back![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: champ_0115_ecology_07
text: This should be handy for your Treasure Hunt.[VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: champ_0115_ecology_08
text: I hope you’ll keep working on that Pokédex of\nyours too—since I did make the app and all![VAR 0x0114(002A)]

label: champ_0115_ecology_09
text: That’s all from me. Just do your best and keep\nout of danger, OK?[VAR 0x0114(002A)]
